verdict.rationale: Anthropic ships an official meta-skill (skill-creator) explicitly designed to author and iteratively improve new skills, plus a formal SKILL.md template, a public specification (agentskills.io) defining required frontmatter/description fields, and a runtime probe confirming skills install cleanly as spec-conformant folders usable by third-party tooling. Community evidence corroborates that skills are simple markdown+YAML folders that users create themselves. missing for 10: no independent hands-on report of an agent using skill-creator autonomously end-to-end to produce a new packaged skill (only docs and install probes, not authoring probes).
